results.name: points_on_singleton_competitor_with_duplicate_targets
results.description: Mean points allocated to a 2-feature singleton competitor in informative scenes where the heard word is also satisfied by duplicate 1-feature minimal targets.

results.name: minimal_duplicates_minus_multifeature_singletons
results.description: Total points on duplicate 1-feature targets minus total points on 2-feature singleton competitors in universal scenes where all four objects satisfy the heard word.

results.name: points_on_full_competitor_with_triplicate_targets
results.description: Mean points allocated to the 3-feature singleton competitor in 4-object informative scenes where the heard word is shared with three 1-feature triplicate targets.

results.name: duplicate_targets_minus_singleton_competitor_points
results.description: Total points allocated to duplicate 2-feature targets minus points allocated to a 3-feature singleton competitor in informative scalar implicature scenes where the heard word is true of all three.

results.name: points_on_minimal_target_in_all_match_display
results.description: Mean points allocated to the unique 1-feature minimal target in 4-object informative scenes where all objects satisfy the heard word and competitors have 2 or 3 features.

results.name: points_on_scalar_competitor_with_duplicate_targets
results.description: Mean points allocated to the 3-feature competitor in informative scalar implicature scenes where the heard word is shared with two 1-feature duplicate targets.

results.name: prior_empty_minus_partial_singleton_with_full_duplicates
results.description: Mean point difference between an empty zero-feature singleton and a 2-feature partial singleton in prior trials containing duplicate full-feature objects.

results.name: prior_full_minus_sparse_in_all_distinct
results.description: Mean point difference between the full-feature object and sparse objects in 3-object prior trials where all objects are distinct.
